notes: Simplifies protected-record maintenance. The Hub Vault Records viewer now includes a direct Edit button on each authorized record. Editing reuses the already-unlocked Vault in place, opens the existing encrypted record form directly, and avoids Maintenance, Source Documents, and a second search. The goal is one unlock, one record, one edit path while preserving the existing encrypted save logic.
name: TEE v3.4.81 — One-Tap Vault Edit
